reason: Renewed by explicit user approval on 2026-10-08 after re-review; first approved 2026-09-08 through 2026-10-08. glib 0.18.5 is tied to the GTK 0.18 API used by the Tauri/Wry Linux webview. The patch starts at glib 0.20, and the latest tauri 2.12.1, tauri-runtime-wry 2.12.1 and wry 0.57.0 still require gtk ^0.18, so no compatible upgrade exists. Re-review on 2026-10-08 scanned the sources of all 524 locked dependency crates plus src-tauri/src: only glib itself references Variant::array_iter_str or VariantStrIter. This is source evidence, not proof about a deployed Linux binary. Re-review the upstream GTK migration or backport and Linux runtime evidence before expiry; do not silently extend this decision.
mitigation: Do not introduce calls to Variant::array_iter_str / VariantStrIter; verify the Linux webview and pursue a compatible backport or coordinated GTK upgrade. This mitigation is source-limited and is not proof of production safety.
fixAvailability: Upstream patch starts at glib 0.20.0; the GTK 0.18 family required by tauri 2.12.1 and wry 0.57.0 cannot take that version as a lockfile-only update.
